matched_queries: Employer responsibilities and worker rights: Conducting recognition ballots, worker voting rights, qualified independent persons and Central Arbitration Committee ballot procedures.
Discover UK employment guidance for Electronic recognition ballots. Task relevance is separate from current law, commencement and a need to edit.

passages.quote:
An employee or group of workers can apply to the Central Arbitration Committee (CAC) to derecognise a non-independent union that the employer recognised voluntarily.

A non-independent union represents workers but has not been given a certificate of independence by the Certification Officer. You can check the official list of trade unions.

You can apply any time after the union has been recognised by the employer.

Apply for a secret ballot

Apply to the CAC to hold a secret ballot of workers to find out if they want the union derecognised.

Download ‘application under part VI of schedule A1’ (PDF, 125KB)

The form must be completed and signed by a worker in the bargaining unit.

Provide evidence (such as letters supporting your application or workplace surveys) for both of the following:

at least 10% of the workers in the bargaining unit want the union to be derecognised

a majority of workers in the bargaining are likely to favour an end to the bargaining arrangements

Send the completed form plus your documents to the CAC. Send a signed copy of the form and evidence to the union and your employer.

What happens next

The CAC has 10 working days to consider your application.

You may be asked to attend a hearing if the CAC needs more information before deciding whether to grant your application.

Your application will either be:

rejected and the union will continue to represent the bargaining unit

accepted and you’ll enter a negotiation period of 20 working days

Taking part in negotiations

The CAC will try to help everyone involved reach an agreement. They may extend the 20-day negotiation period if everyone agrees.

The outcome of the negotiations will be one of the following:

you withdraw your application and the union continues to represent the bargaining unit

the union agrees to end the arrangements and is derecognised

no agreement is reached and the CAC arranges a secret ballot
